::: {#def-bma}
#### Bayesian model averaging

With the [posterior model probabilities](#def-posterior-model-probability)
$\p(M_k \mid \vy)$ of candidate models $M_1, \ldots, M_K$,
**Bayesian model averaging** estimates a quantity $\estimand$
that has the same meaning in every model
by its posterior distribution averaged over the models:

$$
\p(\estimand \mid \vy) \eqdef \sumto{k}{K} \p(\estimand \mid M_k, \vy)\, \p(M_k \mid \vy).
$$
:::
